mo_ta_cong_viec:
Key Responsibilities
1. Engineering Delivery & Execution
Own engineering delivery within the assigned squad, ensuring quality, speed, and reliability
Plan and track engineering priorities, milestones, and deliverables
Identify and resolve blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks proactively
Ensure engineering work aligns with product and business priorities
Drive continuous improvements in development processes and team productivity
2. Technical Leadership & Engineering Standards
Set and maintain engineering standards covering code quality, testing, maintainability, and best practices
Drive technical decisions at the squad level, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
Review technical approaches and provide guidance on architecture and implementation
Identify and address technical debt, technical risks, and engineering bottlenecks
Stay hands-on enough to understand and challenge technical decisions when required
3. People Leadership & Team Development
Lead, coach, mentor, and develop engineers into high-performing team members
Set clear expectations and provide regular feedback on performance and development
Support hiring, onboarding, career development, and succession planning
Build a team culture based on ownership, accountability, continuous learning, and high standards
Develop engineers to operate independently without excessive management oversight
4. Product & Cross-functional Collaboration 
Work closely with Product, QA, Project, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth execution
Align engineering capacity and priorities with product and business requirements
Translate technical complexity into clear communication for non-technical stakeholders
Proactively communicate delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs
5. Continuous Improvement & Innovation 
Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, tools, quality, and efficiency
Encourage adoption of effective engineering practices and technologies
Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
Contribute to initiatives that improve the scalability and reliability of the platform
